//! The names port, implemented with edge.

use foreign_core::outbound::names::interface::NamesPort;
use super::settings::NamesEdgeSettings;

/// The edge names adapter, configured by its settings.
#[derive(Debug)]
pub(crate) struct NamesEdgeAdapter {
    settings: NamesEdgeSettings,
}

impl NamesEdgeAdapter {
    /// The adapter over `settings`, which its composition chooses.
    pub(crate) fn new(settings: NamesEdgeSettings) -> Self {
        Self { settings }
    }
}

impl NamesPort for NamesEdgeAdapter {}
